##### Project general facts

Bulgari Lighthouse is an exclusive residential landmark offering a collection of 4- and 5-bedroom penthouses suspended between the sea and sky. Inspired by the natural form of coral and the timeless elegance of Bulgari, the architecture combines sculptural design with privacy, protection, and panoramic waterfront living. As the tower rises, its distinctive architectural plates gradually broaden, creating larger living spaces and an increasingly light and elegant silhouette.

The penthouses offer a selection of spacious layouts designed around comfort, privacy, and exceptional views. Larger residences feature additional amenities such as private swimming pools and private lift access, while expansive balconies surround the living spaces and open towards uninterrupted views of the sea and city. Thoughtfully designed spaces create an exclusive setting for both peaceful relaxation and entertaining guests.

The interiors reflect understated luxury through natural materials and refined finishes. Living areas are wrapped in curved glass façades, while wide oak flooring, silk-clad columns, natural leather, and silk wallpaper create a warm and sophisticated atmosphere. Bedrooms feature en-suite bathrooms and walk-in closets with direct access to expansive balconies. The show kitchens combine stone flooring, oak boiserie panels, and a striking precious-marble island, with concealed service and wet-kitchen areas. The penthouses are offered unfurnished.


##### Location description and benefits

Jumeira Bay Island is one of Dubai’s most exclusive waterfront destinations, located just off Jumeirah Beach Road and connected to the mainland by a dedicated 300-metre bridge. Shaped like a seahorse and surrounded by the Arabian Gulf, the private island combines seclusion and tranquillity with convenient access to the city.

The island is anchored by the iconic Bulgari Resort Dubai, along with the Bulgari Yacht Club & Marina, offering a prestigious selection of hospitality, dining, leisure, and waterfront experiences. Lush gardens, private beaches, landscaped boulevards, and peaceful surroundings create an elegant resort-style atmosphere focused on privacy and refined living.

Despite its secluded island setting, Jumeira Bay remains well connected to Dubai’s key destinations. The city’s major attractions, business districts, shopping destinations, and cultural landmarks are within easy reach, while the island itself offers spectacular views of the Arabian Gulf and Dubai skyline. This combination of exclusivity, waterfront living, and connectivity makes Jumeira Bay a highly sought-after address for luxury residential living.
